scripts.build: npm run guard:content && astro build && npm run guard:dist
scripts.qa: npm run check && npm run build && npm audit --audit-level=high
scripts.qa:seo:preview: npm run guard:content && GITHUB_PAGES_PREVIEW=true astro build --out-dir .seo-qa/preview && node scripts/check-publishable-content.mjs .seo-qa/preview && QA_DIST_DIR=.seo-qa/preview node scripts/seo-dist-qa.mjs
scripts.qa:seo:release: npm run guard:content && PUBLIC_SITE_RELEASE=true astro build --out-dir .seo-qa/release && node scripts/check-publishable-content.mjs .seo-qa/release && QA_DIST_DIR=.seo-qa/release QA_EXPECT_RELEASED=true node scripts/seo-dist-qa.mjs
